Legend labels ~12pt. Model box: 'Model' red bold underlined ~14pt; I/P and O/P lines black bold ~13pt. Slide number red bold inside yellow circle. recreation_brief: 1. Create a 16:9 slide with white background. 2. Add centered text box at top (~y 4%-14%): 'Classification – Two Dimensional Case', Times New Roman Bold ~28pt, color #C00000 (use en-dash). 3. Top-right (~x 89%, y 11%): insert oval 0.45" diameter, fill #FFEE99, red #C00000 outline 1.5pt, text '11' red bold ~14pt centered. 4. Draw a no-fill rectangle with 2pt #C00000 outline from ~10% to ~92% width and ~18% to ~97% height as the outer frame. 5. Inside it, draw axes with red (#C00000) 1.5pt arrow lines: vertical line at x≈14% slide width from y≈90% up to y≈22% (arrow up); horizontal line at y≈90% from x≈14% to x≈67% (arrow right). Add red bold label 'Weight' rotated 90° CCW just left of the vertical axis top; add red bold label 'Length' just below the horizontal arrowhead. No tick marks or gridlines. 6. Add scatter markers (each ~0.12" circle, white fill): STEEL — 10 hollow circles, 1.5pt black outline, at (as % of 960×540 frame) (50%,29%), (53%,27%), (42%,41%), (30%,53%), (33%,52%), (27%,58%), (29%,59%), (25%,62%), (23%,63%), (21%,66%). WOOD — 12 hollow circles, 1.5pt orange #E09B3D outline, at (56%,49%), (53%,49%), (50%,54%), (53%,54%), (47%,53%), (44%,64%), (41%,65%), (37%,66%), (36%,73%), (31%,78%), (32%,78%), (29%,81%). UNKNOWN — 3 solid #C00000 circles ~0.28" diameter with white bold '?' ~14pt centered, at (45%,33%), (54%,45%), (32%,65%). 7. Top-right inside frame: text box with two centered lines 'Length and Weight of  different samples of' / 'Steel and wood Bars' in blue #0000CC bold serif ~16pt; color the word 'Steel' black and the word 'wood' orange #E09B3D. 8. Below it, build the legend: row 1 small hollow black circle + 'Steel' (black, ~12pt); row 2 small hollow orange circle + 'Wood' (orange); row 3 solid red circle with white '?' + red two-line label 'Belongs to' / 'Which Class ??'. 9. Add the Model box: rectangle ~x 70%-85%, y 51%-63%, fill #FFFEE0, 1.5pt red outline; inside, centered red bold underlined 'Model', then left-aligned black bold lines 'I/P:  Length, Weight' and 'O/P: Class Type'. 10. Optionally place a small white mouse-arrow cursor image overlapping the right end of 'O/P: Class Type' only if replicating the video-frame look; otherwise omit it.
